lane.text: If you're already in business, you're making cash, you're profitable and you're growing, stay in your lane.

stagnant-a.text: If you're in business and you've been stagnant for the last 15, 20 years,

scratch.text: If you've never been in business before, started from scratch, like say you're in my position like I was a few years ago. I go, I'm unemployed, I wanna buy companies, what do I do? Which industry do I go into? I chose healthcare.

why-hc.text: Why did I choose healthcare? Because my personality and my person naturally gravitates towards healthcare. I have a personal affinity towards good health and healthcare and societal health, the community around me.

gp.text: Now, it's not to say that I didn't pivot or change. The first industry that I really wanted to get into was GPs, medical centres.
